verdict.rationale: Headless or automated filing is a fair question for an online registry service, which could expose an API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows a web-based Online Filing Centre and PDF fallback, and the probe explicitly notes that the registry documents no transactional API on any surface checked. The keyless open.canada.ca CKAN API is a separate national open-data platform, an adjacent host capability that earns no credit here.
